task: Identify the most downloaded English-Chinese (en-zh) machine translation model on Huggingface and report its latest performance metrics and usage guidelines.
answer: Most downloaded English-Chinese (en-zh) machine translation model on Hugging Face: facebook/nllb-200-distilled-600M (934k downloads in the Translation + English + Chinese filtered list sorted by Most downloads; model page shows Downloads last month: 933,778). Latest performance metrics (from the model card): evaluated with BLEU, spBLEU, and chrF++ metrics on the Flores-200 dataset, plus human evaluation with the XSTS protocol and toxicity measurement of generated translations. Usage guidelines: a research model not released for production deployment; trained on general-domain text (not medical/legal domains); not intended for document translation; input lengths should not exceed 512 tokens; translations are not certified translations. Usage code: load directly with transformers (AutoTokenizer/AutoModelForSeq2SeqLM.from_pretrained("facebook/nllb-200-distilled-600M")); the pipeline "translation" helper is no longer supported in transformers v5, so use direct loading or transformers<5.0.0.
